Celebrated for its craftsmanship and attention to detail, the company maintains a trusted reputation for quality work across residential and commercial projects.

name: The Nichols Partnership
about: For more than 30 years, The Nichols Partnership has specialised in developing commercial, mixed-use and multifamily real estate in Denver, Boulder and along Colorado's Front Range. The firm pursues unique market opportunities and produces context-responsive developments that prioritise innovative design, flexibility, quality and sustainability.

name: Time Equities
address: 55 Fifth Ave, 15th Floor, New York, NY 10003
about: Time Equities Inc., founded in 1966, is a diversified investment, development, asset and property management company that oversees a portfolio of approximately 43.2 million square feet across 36 U.S. states and several countries. It invests in residential, office, industrial and retail properties, valuing market diversity and long-term real estate opportunities.

name: Trailbreak Partners
about: Trailbreak Partners is a commercial real estate investment and development firm that delivers opportunistic investing with precision. Its purpose is to create lasting value for investors through disciplined real estate investments, closely monitoring markets to identify inefficiencies and manage risk while building strong relationships and a loyal investor base.

name: Tryba Architects
about: Tryba Architects is an interdisciplinary practice that has spent nearly four decades redefining adaptive reuse and transforming buildings and sites into vibrant places that connect people, nature and the urban environment. The firm's context-driven projects balance continuity and change, promoting sustainable and equitable communities through architecture, planning and landscape design.

name: Turner Construction (Denver)
about: Turner Construction is a North America-based, international construction services company and the largest general contractor in the United States. A leading builder across healthcare, education, commercial, sports, aviation, pharmaceutical and green building sectors, Turner delivers projects that shape skylines and communities around the world.

name: Unique Properties
about: Unique Properties, established in 1974 and privately owned by founder Marc Lippitt, is Colorado's most experienced privately owned commercial real estate brokerage firm. With a team of more than 30 brokers, it offers sales, leasing and property management services and is recognised by CoStar and DMCAR for its brokers' success.

name: Urban Villages (Colorado)
about: Urban Villages is a collective of entrepreneurs, environmentalists, artists, developers and investors united by a vision to create forward-thinking, enduring communities. Inspired by European villages, they develop inclusive, vibrant, walkable neighborhoods that celebrate local culture and sustainability, challenging the status quo of American urban development.

name: Weifield Group Contracting
about: Weifield Group Contracting is a privately held, full-service electrical contracting firm with extensive experience across the western United States. Known for its attention to detail and high levels of customer satisfaction, the company provides electrical remodeling, new construction and maintenance services for wholesale, retail, telecom, non-profit and industrial clients.

name: WSP (Denver)
about: WSP is one of the world's leading professional services firms, bringing together engineers, advisors and scientists to shape communities and advance humanity. Through its Future Ready lens, the company's 83,000 employees help clients across property, transportation, water, energy and federal markets address today's challenges while anticipating future trends.

name: Robinson Solutions Demolition & Construction
about: Robinson Solutions Demolition & Construction is a demolition contractor based in Denver, CO. They handle a wide range of demolition projects from complete interior tear-outs for new build-outs to precise removal of walls and fixtures. Available 24 hours.

name: Gorilla Demolition
about: Gorilla Demolition is a family-owned demolition company based in Englewood, CO. They provide demolition services including floor removal, heavy duty cutting, millwork removal, and glass demolition, serving Fort Collins, Colorado Springs, Boulder, and Henderson.

name: Da Demo LLC
about: Da Demo LLC is a demolition contractor based in Highlands Ranch, CO, providing top-notch demolition services in the Denver metro area. With 7+ years of business, they specialize in residential and commercial demolition projects.

name: Consolidated Investment Group
about: Consolidated Investment Group® (CIG) is a leading-edge investment company managing a large, international portfolio. Since its founding in 2003, CIG actively invests in real estate, capital markets, private equity, and philanthropy, with a portfolio that includes investments in more than 70 properties across the U.S.
